visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit restaurant with wooden walls. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a purple long-sleeved shirt, a dark vest, and a black beret, is eating a meal while looking at her phone. She notices a promotional sign on the table. (2) She approaches another woman at a nearby table who is eating edamame. The first woman shows her phone screen and the promotional sign, initiating a conversation with enthusiastic hand gestures. (3) They stand together and take a selfie using a smartphone. The scene then shows a close-up of a plate of four matcha-flavored dessert balls being served. (4) The setting remains the same, but the focus shifts to a young man with short brown hair, wearing a grey sweater with 'THANKS' printed on it over a white collared shirt. He looks at the same promotional sign but appears hesitant and anxious, looking at the same woman eating edamame but deciding not to approach her. (5) He pulls out a Google Pixel 9 Pro smartphone and holds it up to the camera. He sets it on a tripod on an empty chair. (6) He poses for two separate photos by himself, first making a heart shape with one hand. The phone screen interface shows a 'Together' or 'Add Me' feature. The final result on the screen shows two versions of himself combined into one photo. (7) The scene moves to an outdoor rooftop with a scenic view of a river and city skyline. The young woman from the first scene and the young man are seated at a counter. They demonstrate using the phone's feature to take a group photo where they take turns being the photographer, and the phone merges them together. (8) A comparison 'Before and After' graphic appears on the screen, showing the merged photo result. (9) The final scene shows three people standing outdoors in front of a lush green hill, each holding a Google Pixel phone in different colors (Pink, White, Green). The video ends with a shot of the three phones lying on the grass.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic synth-pop BGM. A cheerful female voice narrates the first POV scenario with high energy. (2) A 'munching' sound effect plays as variety text appears. (3) A 'Ding' sound effect signals the introduction of the restaurant promotional text. (4) Dialogue occurs between two females with casual, friendly intonation. A distinct camera 'Click' sound effect plays. (5) A swooshing transition sound marks a shift in the scenario. A male voice takes over, speaking in a more subdued, hesitant, and slightly anxious tone, reflecting the 'I-type' personality trope. (6) Another swoosh transition leads to a more confident male voice introducing the 'Google Pixel 9 Pro'. (7) Digital UI sound effects from the smartphone interface are heard. (8) The upbeat BGM continues throughout as the narrators explain the technical features of the phone's camera. (9) The audio ends with a final energetic musical stinger and a call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Comparison -> Solution -> Tutorial: The video compares how extroverts (E) and introverts (I) handle a promotional offer, introduces the Google Pixel feature as a solution for the introvert, and then provides a tutorial on how the feature benefits everyone.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the Google Pixel 9 Pro, specifically highlighting the 'Add Me' (一起拍) camera feature. It uses the popular MBTI 'E vs I' (Extrovert vs Introvert) personality trope to show how the phone solves social friction—either for introverts who are too shy to ask for help with photos, or for groups who don't want anyone to be left out of the shot as the photographer.
